title: Prospector (MISC, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Prospector is a single-seat mining ship from MISC in Star Citizen. The pilot sits in front of a mining arm that can reach out, and works the laser from the flight seat. In mining mode the right stick's base slider sets the laser power.

panels.name: Prospector: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Prospector's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Mining arm
controls.text: A mining arm that can reach out carries a laser head that can be swapped. The pilot fires it in mining mode.
controls.context: Mining mode sits on base button 13 of the right stick; the trigger fires the laser and the base slider sets its power.

controls.name: Ore containers (four)
controls.text: Four ore containers that can be taken off hold the mined rock.
controls.context: When they are full the miner flies to a station or refinery to sell or refine the ore.
